blind.description: No text or labels can be read on the renders. The model is a stylized architectural half-arch / flying buttress consisting of a vertical rectangular pier and a curving arch that descends to a low foot. The pier features molded trim, a shallow top recess, and a raised trident relief surrounded by wave motifs. The arch is decorated along its contours with dimensional seafoam / stylized wave crests. All surfaces are solid and continuous with no shards, spikes, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, and no parts are unnaturally melted or fused. It stands on its own two integrated rectangular bases, which sit completely flat on the floor without any added slab, disc, or ground plinth. The material is stylized painted stone with deep teal/cyan recessed faces and pale cream/off-white moldings and wave ornaments. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and there is no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a straight, narrow rectangular bar. On the right is the rectangular top of the pillar with a beveled rim enclosing a shallow recessed basin. Extending to the left is the narrow top spine of the arch, flanked by bulbous wave-crest protrusions along both sides, ending at the rectangular foot on the far left.
blind.height_vs_figure: The pillar is slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure at around 6 ft 3 in (the figure reaches just below the capital molding); the overall structure spans approximately 11 ft wide (about twice the figure's height).
